summary: At a small shop the clerk has to count the returns from one customer before accepting another bag.
realLife: Oregon’s 2007 changes allowed smaller stores to set a daily per-person redemption limit.
inGame: The bill catalog supplies the bottle-deposit question. needs: store size and adopted return limit.

turns.what: A shop using the limit explains how many more containers it can take that day.
turns.pulledBy: The shop adopted the permitted daily limit and the customer has returned bottles there today.
turns.writesBack: The tally records what the shop accepted.

turns.what: If mandatory returns end there, the owner takes down the limit sign once outstanding claims expire.
turns.pulledBy: The last redemption obligation at this shop has expired.
turns.writesBack: The old limit comes off the customer notice.
